==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Jiyan
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = I have long been stationed in the borderlands, with little knowledge of entertainment or places of leisure. However, if you are looking for tactics against {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords|Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.}} or beautiful natural vistas, I can provide some suggestions.

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = While the borderlands cannot rival the city's clamor and glamor, they do possess their unique charm. Should you find time, I suggest you come and witness the full moon and twinkling stars that grace the tranquil night skies. Rest assured, your safety will not be a concern; I will be there with you.

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = The {{Extra Effect|Midnight Rangers|Midnight Rangers|The Midnight Rangers are a military force under the Jinzhou Ministry of War, commanded by General Jiyan. They consist of three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations).}} are a source of solace for many, while I see them as a scalpel, with the duty of eradicating maladies. Me? I am the hand that guides this scalpel, I suppose.

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Soldiers of the {{Extra Effect|Midnight Rangers}} have entrusted their lives to me. Therefore, every time I wield the scalpel, I must do so with absolute precision so as not to betray their trust. One day, this scalpel will eradicate all {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords}}, and when that moment arrives, I hope you can witness it with me.

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = Flowers in the Knell Square are planted to honor the deceased. These flowers are of a unique variety, and they require significant attention. Here is a cultivation guide. If I fail to keep my promise of witnessing humanity's victory with you, please plant one of these flowers there for me.


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Jiyan's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = Though I no longer practice medicine, I still discuss medical knowledge with my mother in my spare time. This gourd-shaped pill case is a gift from her the year I joined the {{Extra Effect|Midnight Rangers}}.

|vo_02_02_title              = Jiyan's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Jinzhou Stew is renowned for its wide variety of ingredients and easy preparation, making it a beloved homemade dish in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}}. Having been stationed in the borderlands for most of my time, I sometimes miss that taste.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = In {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, there is a vegetable known as "Bittberry". It possesses a bitter and slightly astringent flavor, and is renowned for its detoxifying properties. When I was young, my mother was somehow convinced "those who can endure bitterness will rise above others." She frequently incorporated this vegetable into our meals. I must confess that its taste was far from pleasant. However, now serving in the army, I have grown accustomed to its flavor. After all, resources are scarce, and it is crucial not to squander them.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = This spear was modeled after the weapon of Captain Beiwang, bearing the significance of quelling chaos and warding off external threats.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = My family has been in the medical profession for generations. I once aspired to follow in their footsteps, saving lives and providing care. However, I soon realized that a doctor could never fully alleviate the pain caused by the {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords}}. It was this realization that led me to join the {{Extra Effect|Midnight Rangers}}. Over the years, I have found my way of bringing solace to the world.


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Mortefi]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Mortefi.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Mortefi

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Jinhsi]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Jinhsi.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = The "battle" Magistrate Jinhsi has been taking on may prove more complicated than our situation in the borderlands: stipulating rules, overseeing trade, ensuring the well-being of the people, and managing the city's functioning all demand her coordination and judgement. Every time I return to {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, I can feel the city's vibrancy and enthusiasm, all thanks to her meticulous governance.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Jinhsi

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Taoqi]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Taoqi.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}'s fortifications.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Taoqi

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Yangyang]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = She can perceive minute changes in the surroundings from the Streams, but there is a limit to the amount of information a single person can take in. Excessive use of this ability might add to her burden, and I hope she won't strain herself.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Yangyang

|vo_04_05_title              = About [[Baizhi]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Baizhi.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.
|vo_04_05_mention            = Baizhi

|vo_04_06_title              = About [[Chixia]]
|vo_04_06_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_06_file               = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg
|vo_04_06_tx                 = That energetic and passionate {{Extra Effect|Patroller|Patroller|Public Security Bureau staff who are responsible for the security issues of their jurisdictions.}}? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}.
|vo_04_06_mention            = Chixia

|vo_04_07_title              = About [[Aalto]]
|vo_04_07_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_07_file               = {character}{language} About Aalto.ogg
|vo_04_07_tx                 = Fog can be an enemy to soldiers on the march, as it limits visibility and complicates situational awareness. However, deploying fog strategically can be an effective move on the battlefield. I have had the opportunity to work with Aalto before, and he is an interesting person indeed.
|vo_04_07_mention            = Aalto

|vo_04_08_title              = About [[Encore]]
|vo_04_08_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_08_file               = {character}{language} About Encore.ogg
|vo_04_08_tx                 = Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.
|vo_04_08_mention            = Encore, Aalto


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = I have worn this vambrace since my first battle. It saved my life countless times. A vambrace like this is believed to bring good luck, ensuring the safe return of soldiers. Though it may show signs of wear, I wish to pass on this luck to you. Additionally, I have prepared a few travel essentials that I hope will prove useful. Happy birthday.


<!-- Idles -->
|vo_06_01_title              = Idle: I
|vo_06_01_file               = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx                 = Victory will be ours.

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file               = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg
|vo_06_02_tx                 = ... (a soft sigh)

|vo_06_03_title              = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file               = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx                 = *Effort Sound*


<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = I have never regretted braving the long night.


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = When danger arises, take cover behind me.

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = The battlefield is dynamic. Do not let your guard down.


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = So you have opted for a prudent strategy this time. Next time, maybe we can consider something more unconventional.

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = With your bold plan, my Qingloong has gained more momentum on the battlefield. I appreciate your assistance.

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = Commanding an army is not a simple task, and sometimes I find myself questioning my own decisions. Going forward, with you staying by my side, I should feel more at ease.
}}
